authorized_changes.observation: Appended normalized time remaining as field 16; prior fields unchanged.
authorized_changes.training_stability: Linear learning-rate decay from 3e-4 to 0 across the unchanged 3M-step budget.

checkpoint_curve_summary.interpretation: Learning-rate decay prevented the prior severe late-return collapse, but no retained checkpoint approached the 0.33 success threshold. The final PPO model is saved after the last optimization update; the ppo-3000000 callback checkpoint is saved when the rollout reaches 3M before that final update, so their deterministic evaluations differ slightly.

trajectory_diagnosis.interpretation: Failures are broadly distributed rather than clustered just outside 2 m. Return remains much more correlated with legs 1-2 than with final-leg reward. Goal observations update correctly at the final-leg transition; the worst cases show correct goal-vector values but insufficient time and/or actions that do not close the final distance.

decision.gate_7_reason: Gate 3 did not pass; the conditional Gate 7 rebuild is therefore not entered.
decision.required_next_action: Stop and discuss before any third revision or further Surveyor retraining.
